About the role

Civic Bridge is looking for a motivated Community Coordinator to support local projects, engage residents and help build a more connected and inclusive Bristol. You'll work closely with community members, partners and our small team to deliver events, outreach and ongoing support initiatives.

Key responsibilities

• Coordinate community events and activities • Liaise with local partners and stakeholders • Support volunteer engagement and outreach • Track progress and report on impact

About the employer

Civic Bridge is a Bristol-based charity working to build stronger, fairer and more connected communities through local action and collaboration.
